blocks.zh: 學習目標 — Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解潔淨室內各類清潔材料（拖把頭 mop heads、擦拭布 wipers、水桶 buckets）的選用原則，以及無菌等級與可重複使用性的差異。
blocks.en: Understand the principles for selecting cleaning materials in cleanrooms (mop heads, wipers, buckets), and the differences between sterile grade and reusability.

blocks.zh: 掌握非產品接觸設備表面（non-product-contact equipment surfaces）、HVAC 空氣處理系統及地板排水的清潔消毒策略。
blocks.en: Master the cleaning and disinfection strategies for non-product-contact equipment surfaces, HVAC air-handling systems and floor drains.

blocks.zh: 理解凍乾機（lyophilizer）腔體內部清潔消毒的 GMP 要求，包括孢子殺滅劑（sporicide）應用與批次記錄（batch record）連結。
blocks.en: Understand the GMP requirements for cleaning and disinfecting the interior of lyophilizer chambers, including sporicide application and the link to the batch record.

blocks.zh: 認識消毒劑（尤其是含氯製劑）對不銹鋼設備造成腐蝕（corrosion）的風險，以及材料相容性驗證（compatibility validation）的必要性。
blocks.en: Recognize the risk of corrosion of stainless steel equipment caused by disinfectants (especially chlorine-based agents) and the need for compatibility validation.

blocks.zh: 清潔材料：拖把頭、擦拭布、水桶  |  TR70 §9.3–9.4
blocks.en: Cleaning Materials: Mop Heads, Wipers, Buckets  |  TR70 §9.3–9.4

blocks.zh: 清潔材料的選擇與管控
blocks.en: Selection and Control of Cleaning Materials

blocks.zh: 清潔材料（拖把頭 mop heads、擦拭布 wipers、水桶 buckets）的選用直接影響整個清潔消毒程序的效果。材料必須根據其物理特性、與化學藥劑的相容性，以及使用場所的潔淨等級來選擇。
blocks.en: The selection of cleaning materials (mop heads, wipers, buckets) directly affects the effectiveness of the entire cleaning and disinfection procedure. Materials must be selected according to their physical properties, their compatibility with the chemical agents, and the cleanliness grade of the place of use.

blocks.zh: 擦拭布 Wipers
blocks.en: Wipers

blocks.zh: 擦拭布用於所有潔淨室等級，主要功能是提供機械動作並將化學藥劑傳送至表面。選擇重點如下：
blocks.en: Wipers are used in all cleanroom grades; their main function is to provide mechanical action and deliver the chemical agent to the surface. Key selection points:

blocks.zh: A/B 級 (ISO 5)：必須使用無菌伽瑪射線照射（γ-irradiated）擦拭布。預先浸潤的無菌擦拭布（pre-saturated sterile wipers）是首選，可確保藥劑量的一致性，並消除擦拭布本身的污染風險。
blocks.en: Grade A/B (ISO 5): sterile gamma-irradiated (γ-irradiated) wipers must be used. Pre-saturated sterile wipers are preferred because they ensure a consistent amount of agent and eliminate the risk of contamination from the wiper itself.

blocks.zh: C/D 級：根據風險評估，可使用無菌或非無菌擦拭布。非無菌擦拭布仍須具備低微粒、低掉纖維特性。
blocks.en: Grade C/D: sterile or non-sterile wipers may be used, based on risk assessment. Non-sterile wipers must still be low-particulate and low-fiber-shedding.

blocks.zh: 單次使用 vs. 可重複使用：單次使用擦拭布可消除表面間的交叉污染風險。可重複使用擦拭布在再次使用前必須按照驗證程序進行洗滌與重新滅菌（laundering and re-sterilization）。
blocks.en: Single-use vs. reusable: single-use wipers eliminate the risk of cross-contamination between surfaces. Reusable wipers must be laundered and re-sterilized according to a validated procedure before they are used again.

blocks.zh: 材質：聚酯/纖維素混紡布料常見。纖維脫落（fiber shedding）程度及與清潔藥劑的相容性必須經過評估。
blocks.en: Material: polyester/cellulose blend fabrics are common. The degree of fiber shedding and compatibility with the cleaning agents must be evaluated.

blocks.zh: 關鍵注意事項 — 擦拭布殘留物
blocks.en: Key Consideration - Wiper Residues

blocks.zh: 化學藥劑殘留物、擦拭布散落的游離纖維及黏合劑成分，都可能成為產品接觸面或鄰近產品表面的污染來源。擦拭布的種類與化學特性必須納入正式的驗證文件包中。
blocks.en: Chemical residues, loose fibers shed from wipers and binder components can all become sources of contamination on product-contact surfaces or surfaces adjacent to the product. The type and chemical properties of the wiper must be included in the formal validation package.

blocks.zh: 拖把頭 Mop Heads
blocks.en: Mop Heads

blocks.zh: 拖把是將清潔劑和消毒劑施用於牆面和地板的主要工具。拖把頭必須針對程序中使用的消毒劑及孢子殺滅劑（sporicides）進行相容性驗證（compatibility validation）。主要要求：
blocks.en: Mops are the main tool for applying cleaning agents and disinfectants to walls and floors. Mop heads must be validated for compatibility with the disinfectants and sporicides used in the procedure. Main requirements:

blocks.zh: 用於 A/B 級區域的拖把頭必須是無菌狀態——通常採用 γ-irradiated 的單次使用頭，或已經過驗證程序洗滌與重新滅菌的可重複使用頭。
blocks.en: Mop heads used in Grade A/B areas must be sterile - usually single-use γ-irradiated heads, or reusable heads that have been laundered and re-sterilized by a validated procedure.

blocks.zh: 可重複使用的拖把頭若未正確洗滌，會累積生物負載（bioburden）。驗證洗滌程序需定義洗滌溫度、洗劑、沖洗週期及重新滅菌方式。
blocks.en: Reusable mop heads that are not laundered properly will accumulate bioburden. The validated laundering procedure must define the wash temperature, detergent, rinse cycles and re-sterilization method.

blocks.zh: 擰乾（wringing）機制影響液體保留量：擰乾不足將導致表面潤濕不充分，消毒劑接觸時間（contact time）不足。
blocks.en: The wringing mechanism affects the amount of liquid retained: insufficient wringing results in inadequate wetting of the surface and insufficient disinfectant contact time.

blocks.zh: 拖把桿與絞桶（wringer buckets）也須納入 C&D 程序；它們是次要污染的潛在來源。
blocks.en: Mop handles and wringer buckets must also be included in the C&D procedure; they are potential sources of secondary contamination.

blocks.zh: 水桶 Buckets
blocks.en: Buckets

blocks.zh: 用於配製和盛裝清潔溶液的水桶應：
blocks.en: Buckets used to prepare and hold cleaning solutions should:

blocks.zh: 專屬於特定區域或等級，以防止交叉污染（cross-contamination）。
blocks.en: Be dedicated to a specific area or grade to prevent cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: 每次使用後，以適用於該區域設備的相同驗證程序進行清潔和消毒。
blocks.en: Be cleaned and disinfected after each use, using the same validated procedure that applies to equipment in that area.

blocks.zh: 定期檢查裂縫、腐蝕凹坑或殘留積垢，此類缺陷易滋生微生物。
blocks.en: Be inspected regularly for cracks, corrosion pits or residual buildup, since such defects readily harbor microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 正確標示使用中的清潔劑名稱、濃度及配製日期/時間，確保溶液不超過其已驗證的使用有效期。
blocks.en: Be properly labeled with the name of the cleaning agent in use, its concentration and the preparation date/time, to ensure the solution does not exceed its validated in-use expiry period.

blocks.zh: Sterile vs. Non-Sterile Cleaning Materials by Grade / 各等級無菌與非無菌清潔材料比較
blocks.en: Sterile vs. Non-Sterile Cleaning Materials by Grade

blocks.zh: 設備表面與 HVAC 空氣處理系統表面  |  TR70 §9.4.1–9.4.3
blocks.en: Equipment Surfaces and HVAC Air-Handling System Surfaces  |  TR70 §9.4.1–9.4.3

blocks.zh: 9.4.1 非產品接觸設備表面
blocks.en: 9.4.1 Non-Product-Contact Equipment Surfaces

blocks.zh: 非產品接觸設備表面（non-product-contact equipment surfaces）位於產品接觸面的鄰近區域，因其位置關鍵，所有在這些表面使用的清潔藥劑、消毒劑（disinfectant）、孢子殺滅劑（sporicide）、擦拭布或其他材料，均不得留下可能轉移至產品接觸面的殘留物。
blocks.en: Non-product-contact equipment surfaces are located in areas adjacent to product-contact surfaces. Because of this critical location, any cleaning agent, disinfectant, sporicide, wiper or other material used on these surfaces must not leave residues that could be transferred to product-contact surfaces.

blocks.zh: 非產品接觸表面的清潔流程：
blocks.en: Cleaning process for non-product-contact surfaces:

blocks.zh: 預清潔（pre-cleaning）：在嘗試消毒之前，先移除過去的產品溢漏、玻璃碎片（來自瓶罐、針筒、安瓿）、破損橡膠塞、損毀蓋子及其他異物。
blocks.en: Pre-cleaning: before attempting disinfection, first remove previous product spills, glass fragments (from vials, syringes, ampoules), broken rubber stoppers, damaged caps and other foreign matter.

blocks.zh: 消毒（disinfection）：預清潔完成後，以有效的消毒劑或孢子殺滅劑噴灑或擦拭表面，並讓表面保持濕潤達到規定的接觸時間（contact time）。
blocks.en: Disinfection: after pre-cleaning, spray or wipe the surface with an effective disinfectant or sporicide and keep the surface wet for the specified contact time.

blocks.zh: IPA 擦拭：接觸時間到達後，若使用含殘留特性的孢子殺滅劑或消毒劑，所有表面均應以 70% 異丙醇（isopropyl alcohol，IPA）進行擦拭去除殘留。
blocks.en: IPA wipe-down: after the contact time has elapsed, if a sporicide or disinfectant with residual properties was used, all surfaces should be wiped with 70% isopropyl alcohol (IPA) to remove the residue.

blocks.zh: 9.4.2 工作表面 Work Surfaces
blocks.en: 9.4.2 Work Surfaces

blocks.zh: 工作台面、推車、設置區域等工作表面可能鄰近產品或產品接觸組件。在消毒前進行預清潔（precleaning）可提升消毒效果。清潔後，使用消毒劑或孢子殺滅劑消毒；若所用藥劑有殘留性，需使用 70% IPA 噴灑並乾布擦拭。頻率通常為每日，但應依實際使用情況調整。
blocks.en: Work surfaces such as workbenches, carts and set-up areas may be adjacent to product or product-contact components. Pre-cleaning before disinfection improves disinfection effectiveness. After cleaning, disinfect with a disinfectant or sporicide; if the agent used leaves a residue, spray with 70% IPA and wipe with a dry cloth. The frequency is usually daily but should be adjusted to actual use.

blocks.zh: 9.4.3 非結構性及難以清潔的表面
blocks.en: 9.4.3 Nonstructural and Hard-to-Clean Surfaces

blocks.zh: 結構性表面（牆壁、天花板、地板）及充填設備應定期進行清潔消毒，頻率應依環境監測（environmental monitoring，EM）結果及風險分析決定。非結構性表面（nonstructural surfaces）同樣需要關注，因為它們也可能污染潔淨室環境。
blocks.en: Structural surfaces (walls, ceilings, floors) and filling equipment should be cleaned and disinfected periodically, at a frequency determined by environmental monitoring (EM) results and risk analysis. Nonstructural surfaces also need attention because they too can contaminate the cleanroom environment.

blocks.zh: 表面分為兩類：
blocks.en: Surfaces fall into two categories:

blocks.zh: 常規非結構性表面：儲槽（tanks）、推車（carts）、工作台面（countertops）、架子（racks）、已包裝物料、儲物箱（storage bins）、樓梯、工作表面、非產品接觸面、監測儀器、儀表。
blocks.en: Routine nonstructural surfaces: tanks, carts, countertops, racks, packaged materials, storage bins, stairs, work surfaces, non-product-contact surfaces, monitoring instruments, gauges.

blocks.zh: 難以清潔的表面（hard-to-clean surfaces）：門頂、軌道（tracks）、輸送帶（conveyors）、電話、設備腳架與腿部、儲槽/推車/設備底部、輪子、管路（tubing/pipes）外表面、培養箱、冰箱、冷藏室、工具（可能需要滅菌）。
blocks.en: Hard-to-clean surfaces: tops of doors, tracks, conveyors, telephones, equipment stands and legs, undersides of tanks/carts/equipment, wheels, exterior surfaces of tubing/pipes, incubators, refrigerators, cold rooms, tools (which may need to be sterilized).

blocks.zh: HVAC 空氣處理系統表面
blocks.en: HVAC Air-Handling System Surfaces

blocks.zh: 潔淨室中的 HVAC 組件——HEPA 過濾器（HEPA filters）、送風靜壓箱（air supply plenums）、回風格柵（return air grilles）和風管——需要專屬的清潔方式：
blocks.en: HVAC components in cleanrooms - HEPA filters, air supply plenums, return air grilles and ductwork - require dedicated cleaning approaches:

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器：任何情況下均不得以清潔或消毒藥劑潤濕。意外潤濕會為黴菌生長創造條件，並可能損壞過濾器基材，導致過濾器完整性（filter integrity）受損。
blocks.en: HEPA filters: must never be wetted with cleaning or disinfecting agents under any circumstances. Accidental wetting creates conditions for mold growth and can damage the filter media, compromising filter integrity.

blocks.zh: 送風靜壓箱：按計劃定期清潔。透過目視檢查粉塵或微粒積累情況來決定清潔頻率。噴霧（fogging）或氣體薰蒸（gassing）可能滲入靜壓箱空間，但須保護過濾器完整性。
blocks.en: Air supply plenums: clean periodically according to a plan. The cleaning frequency is determined by visual inspection for dust or particle accumulation. Fogging or gassing may penetrate the plenum space, but filter integrity must be protected.

blocks.zh: 回風格柵：以浸有消毒劑的擦拭布擦拭。格柵會積累微粒，清潔頻率應根據 EM 趨勢數據決定——若 EM 出現不良趨勢，應提高格柵清潔頻率。
blocks.en: Return air grilles: wipe with wipers saturated with disinfectant. Grilles accumulate particles, and the cleaning frequency should be based on EM trend data - if EM shows an adverse trend, increase the frequency of grille cleaning.

blocks.zh: 清潔計劃與 EM 數據掛鉤：HVAC 表面清潔不固定於某一日曆時間表，而是動態回應環境監測趨勢——特別是微粒計數升高或微生物超標時。
blocks.en: Linking the cleaning plan to EM data: cleaning of HVAC surfaces is not fixed to a calendar schedule but responds dynamically to environmental monitoring trends - especially elevated particle counts or microbial excursions.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：EM 數據驅動的清潔計劃
blocks.en: Core concept: EM data-driven cleaning plans

blocks.zh: 以「每月清潔一次」的固定計劃作為唯一依據是不夠的。GMP 要求清潔頻率應具備回應性——當 EM 趨勢顯示微粒或微生物數量上升時，這是強化 HVAC 表面清潔的訊號，而非等待下一個計劃週期。
blocks.en: A fixed "once a month" schedule as the sole basis is not sufficient. GMP requires the cleaning frequency to be responsive - when EM trends show rising particle or microbial counts, this is a signal to intensify cleaning of HVAC surfaces, rather than waiting for the next scheduled cycle.

blocks.zh: 地板、排水口與特殊表面  |  TR70 §9.5
blocks.en: Floors, Drains and Special Surfaces  |  TR70 §9.5

blocks.zh: 地板清潔原則
blocks.en: Principles of Floor Cleaning

blocks.zh: 潔淨室地板因重力沉降的微粒及人員走動，是生物負載（bioburden）最高的表面之一。有效的地板清潔需要：
blocks.en: Cleanroom floors are among the surfaces with the highest bioburden because of particles settling by gravity and personnel movement. Effective floor cleaning requires:

blocks.zh: 方向性拖地：始終從最乾淨的區域往最髒的區域拖，從較高等級的房間往較低等級的房間拖。這可防止污染物被帶回較乾淨的區域。
blocks.en: Directional mopping: always mop from the cleanest area to the dirtiest, and from higher-grade rooms to lower-grade rooms. This prevents contaminants from being carried back into cleaner areas.

blocks.zh: 機械動作：拖地提供了清除黏附微生物和微粒所需的機械動作，僅靠噴灑對地板是不夠的。
blocks.en: Mechanical action: mopping provides the mechanical action needed to remove adherent microorganisms and particles; spraying alone is not sufficient for floors.

blocks.zh: 液體移除：以清潔劑拖地後，必須用無菌乾拖把、無菌乾擦拭布或 HEPA 過濾濕式吸塵器移除多餘液體及懸浮污染物，以備接下來施用消毒劑。
blocks.en: Liquid removal: after mopping with a cleaning agent, excess liquid and suspended contaminants must be removed with a sterile dry mop, sterile dry wipers or a HEPA-filtered wet vacuum, in preparation for the subsequent application of disinfectant.

blocks.zh: 消毒接觸時間：地板表面乾燥後，應充分潤濕地塗布無菌（A/B 級）或無菌/非無菌（C/D 級）消毒劑，消毒劑必須與表面保持驗證要求的接觸時間。
blocks.en: Disinfectant contact time: once the floor surface is dry, apply a sterile (Grade A/B) or sterile/non-sterile (Grade C/D) disinfectant with thorough wetting, and the disinfectant must remain in contact with the surface for the validated contact time.

blocks.zh: 區域邊界：入口黏塵墊（tacky mats）和跨越屏障（step-over barriers）定義區域邊界，減少區域間的微粒轉移。這些物件也必須納入 C&D 程序。
blocks.en: Area boundaries: tacky mats and step-over barriers define area boundaries and reduce particle transfer between areas. These items must also be included in the C&D procedure.

blocks.zh: 排水口 Drains
blocks.en: Drains

blocks.zh: 排水口在潔淨室中存在獨特的微生物挑戰：
blocks.en: Drains present unique microbial challenges in cleanrooms:

blocks.zh: 排水口本身是高生物負載區域。積水、生物膜（biofilm）和有機物在排水彎管（drain traps）及周圍表面積聚。
blocks.en: The drain itself is a high-bioburden area. Standing water, biofilm and organic matter accumulate in drain traps and surrounding surfaces.

blocks.zh: C 級和 D 級區域的排水口應定期清潔和消毒。強烈建議對排水口表面及彎管內部施用孢子殺滅劑。
blocks.en: Drains in Grade C and D areas should be cleaned and disinfected regularly. Applying a sporicide to the drain surface and the inside of the trap is strongly recommended.

blocks.zh: A 級或 B 級區域通常不設置排水口（開放式排水口與無菌製程不相容）。若存在，在無菌操作進行時必須密封或加蓋。
blocks.en: Grade A or B areas are generally not fitted with drains (open drains are incompatible with aseptic processing). If present, they must be sealed or capped while aseptic operations are in progress.

blocks.zh: 排水口清潔必須有文件記錄，SOP 中應定義頻率和使用藥劑，結果應與附近監測點的環境監測數據相關聯。
blocks.en: Drain cleaning must be documented; the SOP should define the frequency and agents used, and the results should be correlated with EM data from nearby monitoring locations.

blocks.zh: 門簾與傳遞窗區域 Curtains and Pass-Through Areas
blocks.en: Curtains and Pass-Through Areas

blocks.zh: 潔淨室門簾（curtains）因其較軟的表面特性而面臨特殊挑戰。在顯微鏡下觀察，門簾表面比牆面更粗糙，為污垢和微生物提供了更多受清潔和消毒藥劑保護的藏匿空間。
blocks.en: Cleanroom curtains present particular challenges because of their softer surface characteristics. Under a microscope, a curtain surface is rougher than a wall surface, providing more hiding places for dirt and microorganisms that are protected from cleaning and disinfecting agents.

blocks.zh: 門簾應先以高界面活性劑基底清潔劑或 70% IPA，透過機械擦拭或拖地動作進行清潔。
blocks.en: Curtains should first be cleaned with a high-surfactant-based cleaner or 70% IPA, using mechanical wiping or mopping action.

blocks.zh: 清潔後，以低殘留的消毒劑或孢子殺滅劑（如過氧化氫或過氧乙酸 peracetic acid）消毒。接觸時間必須達到驗證要求（最少 5 分鐘）。
blocks.en: After cleaning, disinfect with a low-residue disinfectant or sporicide (such as hydrogen peroxide or peracetic acid). The contact time must meet the validated requirement (minimum 5 minutes).

blocks.zh: 若使用中至高殘留藥劑（酚類 phenolic、四級銨化合物 quaternary ammonium 或漂白劑），門簾隨後必須用 70% IPA 和乾布擦拭以去除殘留物，以防止殘留物轉移至關鍵區域或充填設備。
blocks.en: If a medium- to high-residue agent (phenolic, quaternary ammonium compound or bleach) is used, the curtain must subsequently be wiped with 70% IPA and a dry cloth to remove the residue, preventing transfer of residue to critical areas or filling equipment.

blocks.zh: 由於人員接觸頻率較高，門簾清潔頻率應高於牆面。
blocks.en: Because of the higher frequency of personnel contact, curtains should be cleaned more frequently than walls.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：排水口是污染的「陷阱」
blocks.en: Analogy: the drain as a contamination "trap"

blocks.zh: 想像排水口是一個持續接收各種污染物的「儲存庫」——每次地板清潔的污水、人員攜入的微生物、環境中沉降的微粒，最終都集中在排水彎管中。若不定期以孢子殺滅劑處理，排水口可能成為逆向污染的來源，在地板清潔後反而將微生物帶回環境。
blocks.en: Imagine a drain as a "reservoir" that continually receives all kinds of contaminants - wastewater from every floor cleaning, microorganisms brought in by personnel and particles settling from the environment all end up concentrated in the drain trap. If it is not treated regularly with a sporicide, the drain can become a source of reverse contamination, carrying microorganisms back into the environment after the floor has been cleaned.

blocks.zh: 凍乾機清潔消毒 / 腐蝕預防  |  TR70 §9.6–9.7
blocks.en: Lyophilizer Cleaning and Disinfection / Corrosion Prevention  |  TR70 §9.6–9.7

blocks.zh: 凍乾機的清潔消毒
blocks.en: Cleaning and Disinfection of Lyophilizers

blocks.zh: 凍乾機（lyophilizer，即冷凍乾燥機）是無菌充填製程中最關鍵的 C&D 設備之一。其密閉腔體在冷凍操作過程中會積聚冷凝水，加上低溫環境的特殊性，使微生物污染控制面臨複雜挑戰。
blocks.en: The lyophilizer (freeze dryer) is one of the most critical pieces of C&D equipment in aseptic filling processes. Its closed chamber accumulates condensate during freezing operations, and together with the particular nature of the low-temperature environment, this makes microbial contamination control complex.

blocks.zh: 凍乾機 C&D 的主要要求
blocks.en: Main C&D requirements for lyophilizers

blocks.zh: 每個週期後進行腔體清潔：每次生產週期完成後必須清潔凍乾機腔體。在下一批次裝載前，必須移除產品殘留物、橡膠塞碎片、破損玻璃瓶和冷凝水。
blocks.en: Chamber cleaning after every cycle: the lyophilizer chamber must be cleaned after every production cycle. Product residues, rubber stopper fragments, broken vials and condensate must be removed before the next batch is loaded.

blocks.zh: 門墊圈（door gasket）檢查：每次清潔時必須檢查門密封墊圈的完整性。墊圈上的裂縫、切痕或生物殘留物會危害腔體無菌性，並提供污染藏匿的空間。
blocks.en: Door gasket inspection: the integrity of the door gasket must be inspected at every cleaning. Cracks, cuts or biological residues on the gasket compromise chamber sterility and provide hiding places for contamination.

blocks.zh: 棚架冷凝水管理（shelf condensation management）：棚架表面在冷凍和初級乾燥階段會積累冷凝水。週期完成後，棚架必須用無菌擦拭布擦拭清潔，再施用孢子殺滅劑。棚架表面的積水可能稀釋消毒劑並降低效力。
blocks.en: Shelf condensation management: condensate accumulates on shelf surfaces during the freezing and primary drying phases. After the cycle is complete, the shelves must be wiped clean with sterile wipers before the sporicide is applied. Standing water on shelf surfaces can dilute the disinfectant and reduce its efficacy.

blocks.zh: 孢子殺滅劑（sporicide）處理：凍乾機內部通常需要進行孢子殺滅劑處理——特別是在產品活動後、環境監測超標後，或例行定期去污染（periodic decontamination）時。常用孢子殺滅劑包括 0.52% 次氯酸鈉（sodium hypochlorite）、過氧乙酸（peracetic acid）溶液，或氣化過氧化氫（VHP，vaporized hydrogen peroxide）。VHP 的優勢在於以氣態滲透所有內部表面，無需手動擦拭。
blocks.en: Sporicide treatment: the interior of the lyophilizer usually requires sporicide treatment - especially after product activity, after an EM excursion, or during routine periodic decontamination. Commonly used sporicides include 0.52% sodium hypochlorite, peracetic acid solution, or vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP). The advantage of VHP is that it penetrates all internal surfaces as a gas, with no manual wiping required.

blocks.zh: 冷凝器清潔：冷凝器在運作中積累冰霜。除霜後必須清潔和消毒冷凝器，排出冷凝水，並對冷凝器表面進行處理以防止生物膜（biofilm）形成。
blocks.en: Condenser cleaning: the condenser accumulates frost during operation. After defrosting, the condenser must be cleaned and disinfected, the condensate drained, and the condenser surfaces treated to prevent biofilm formation.

blocks.zh: GMP 文件要求
blocks.en: GMP Documentation Requirements

blocks.zh: 凍乾機 C&D 是關鍵 GMP 活動。在如無菌 CDMO 的製造場所（例如 TWi），所有凍乾機 C&D 活動必須：
blocks.en: Lyophilizer C&D is a critical GMP activity. At manufacturing sites such as an aseptic CDMO (for example, TWi), all lyophilizer C&D activities must be:

blocks.zh: 記錄在每批在該凍乾機中處理的批次記錄（batch record，BMR）中。
blocks.en: Recorded in the batch record (BMR) of every batch processed in that lyophilizer.

blocks.zh: 與環境監測（EM）結果連結——凍乾機腔體及裝載區域的 EM 樣本應與 C&D 記錄一同審查，以確認清潔有效且環境處於受控狀態。
blocks.en: Linked to environmental monitoring (EM) results - EM samples from the lyophilizer chamber and loading area should be reviewed together with the C&D records to confirm that cleaning is effective and the environment is under control.

blocks.zh: 依照有版本管控的核准 SOP 執行。執行凍乾機 C&D 的操作人員必須接受程序培訓和資格確認（qualified）。
blocks.en: Performed according to an approved, version-controlled SOP. Operators performing lyophilizer C&D must be trained and qualified in the procedure.

blocks.zh: 定期接受驗證審查——凍乾機 C&D 程序需要驗證數據，證明孢子殺滅劑接觸時間、藥劑濃度和施用方式能對目標微生物達到對數降低（log reduction）目標。
blocks.en: Subject to periodic validation review - the lyophilizer C&D procedure requires validation data showing that the sporicide contact time, agent concentration and application method achieve the log reduction target against the target microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 法規監管重點
blocks.en: Regulatory Focus

blocks.zh: FDA 和 EMA 稽查結果中，凍乾機清潔消毒不充分頻繁被引用為環境監測超標和無菌保證（sterility assurance）失效的原因之一。凍乾機是密閉低溫環境，若 C&D 操作未嚴格控制，水分和殘留物可能長期存在。
blocks.en: In FDA and EMA inspection findings, inadequate lyophilizer cleaning and disinfection is frequently cited as one of the causes of EM excursions and failures of sterility assurance. The lyophilizer is a closed, low-temperature environment; if C&D operations are not tightly controlled, moisture and residues can persist for a long time.

blocks.zh: 腐蝕預防——消毒劑與不銹鋼的相容性
blocks.en: Corrosion Prevention - Disinfectant Compatibility with Stainless Steel

blocks.zh: 無菌製造設施中使用的許多消毒劑和孢子殺滅劑，若使用不當或濃度過高，對不銹鋼設備表面具有腐蝕性（corrosive）。了解材料相容性（material compatibility）對於保護設備壽命和防止腐蝕副產品污染產品至關重要。
blocks.en: Many disinfectants and sporicides used in aseptic manufacturing facilities are corrosive to stainless steel equipment surfaces if used improperly or at excessive concentrations. Understanding material compatibility is essential to protect equipment life and to prevent corrosion by-products from contaminating the product.

blocks.zh: 高腐蝕風險的消毒劑
blocks.en: Disinfectants with high corrosion risk

blocks.zh: 含氯製劑（chlorine-based agents）——次氯酸鈉（sodium hypochlorite）/漂白劑：這類藥劑孢子殺滅效果極佳，但對 316L 不銹鋼、鋁及其他金屬腐蝕性最強。點蝕（pitting corrosion，在表面形成小孔的局部腐蝕）是主要失效模式。風險隨濃度、溫度和接觸時間增加而升高。氯溶液不得在不銹鋼表面上的接觸時間超過已驗證的範圍。
blocks.en: Chlorine-based agents - sodium hypochlorite / bleach: these agents have excellent sporicidal effect but are the most corrosive to 316L stainless steel, aluminum and other metals. Pitting corrosion (localized corrosion that forms small holes in the surface) is the main failure mode. The risk rises with concentration, temperature and contact time. Chlorine solutions must not remain in contact with stainless steel surfaces for longer than the validated range.

blocks.zh: 過氧乙酸（peracetic acid，PAA）：有效的孢子殺滅劑；在一般使用濃度下腐蝕性低於氯，但仍需沖洗。用於循環系統的高濃度過氧乙酸可加速焊縫（welds）和表面缺陷的腐蝕。
blocks.en: Peracetic acid (PAA): an effective sporicide; at typical use concentrations it is less corrosive than chlorine but still requires rinsing. High concentrations of peracetic acid used in circulating systems can accelerate corrosion of welds and surface defects.

blocks.zh: 過氧化氫（hydrogen peroxide，H₂O₂）：在標準濃度下腐蝕風險通常低於氯。高濃度 VHP 應用可能影響某些聚合物和彈性體，而非不銹鋼。
blocks.en: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂): at standard concentrations the corrosion risk is generally lower than that of chlorine. High-concentration VHP applications may affect certain polymers and elastomers rather than stainless steel.

blocks.zh: 相容性數據與沖洗程序（Compatibility Data and Rinsing Protocols）
blocks.en: Compatibility Data and Rinsing Protocols

blocks.zh: 在 C&D 程序中引入任何新的消毒劑或孢子殺滅劑之前，必須取得正式的材料相容性數據：
blocks.en: Before any new disinfectant or sporicide is introduced into the C&D procedure, formal material compatibility data must be obtained:

blocks.zh: 相容性測試應涵蓋設施中實際使用的建構材料：不銹鋼等級、聚合物、墊圈材料、塗漆表面、陽極氧化鋁（anodized aluminum）和地板塗層。
blocks.en: Compatibility testing should cover the materials of construction actually used in the facility: stainless steel grades, polymers, gasket materials, painted surfaces, anodized aluminum and floor coatings.

blocks.zh: 驗證過的沖洗程序必須定義沖洗藥劑（無菌注射用水 WFI 或純化水 purified water）、沖洗體積、沖洗週期次數，以及沖洗後表面消毒劑殘留量的可接受限值。
blocks.en: The validated rinsing procedure must define the rinsing agent (sterile water for injection (WFI) or purified water), rinse volume, number of rinse cycles, and the acceptable limit for residual disinfectant on the surface after rinsing.

blocks.zh: 必須建立並執行接觸時間限制。操作人員不得讓孢子殺滅劑或含氯製劑在沖洗前乾燥於不銹鋼表面上。
blocks.en: Contact time limits must be established and enforced. Operators must not allow sporicides or chlorine-based agents to dry on stainless steel surfaces before rinsing.

blocks.zh: 腐蝕檢查應作為設備維護和清潔驗證的常規部分——可見點蝕、變色或表面粗糙化應觸發調查，並可能導致 C&D 程序的變更。
blocks.en: Corrosion inspection should be a routine part of equipment maintenance and cleaning validation - visible pitting, discoloration or surface roughening should trigger an investigation and may lead to changes in the C&D procedure.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 充填工廠的含氯藥劑沖洗
blocks.en: Practical Application - Chlorine Agent Rinsing at a Filling Plant

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填 CDMO（如 TWi）的作業中，次氯酸鈉（sodium hypochlorite）常用於凍乾機腔體和設備表面的定期孢子殺滅處理。驗證程序必須規定，在孢子殺滅劑接觸時間結束後的特定時間窗口內，必須以 WFI 沖洗表面。未能在此時間窗口內沖洗，已是充填線設備不銹鋼點蝕的根本原因，導致表面資格確認失敗和計劃外設備更換。
blocks.en: In the operations of an aseptic filling CDMO (such as TWi), sodium hypochlorite is commonly used for periodic sporicidal treatment of lyophilizer chambers and equipment surfaces. The validated procedure must specify that surfaces be rinsed with WFI within a defined time window after the sporicide contact time ends. Failure to rinse within this window has been the root cause of stainless steel pitting on filling line equipment, leading to failed surface qualification and unplanned equipment replacement.

blocks.zh: Disinfectant Corrosion Risk Summary / 消毒劑腐蝕風險摘要
blocks.en: Disinfectant Corrosion Risk Summary

blocks.zh: 本節重點摘要  |  TR70 Section 4b
blocks.en: Key Takeaways of This Section  |  TR70 Section 4b

blocks.zh: 核心原則摘要 — Section 9.0 Part 2
blocks.en: Summary of Core Principles - Section 9.0 Part 2

blocks.zh: 清潔材料
blocks.en: Cleaning Materials

blocks.zh: A/B 級需使用無菌 γ-irradiated 擦拭布和拖把頭。
blocks.en: Grade A/B requires sterile γ-irradiated wipers and mop heads.

blocks.zh: 可重複使用拖把頭必須依驗證程序進行洗滌和重新滅菌。
blocks.en: Reusable mop heads must be laundered and re-sterilized according to a validated procedure.

blocks.zh: 單次使用材料消除交叉污染風險，但提高廢棄物管理要求。
blocks.en: Single-use materials eliminate the risk of cross-contamination but increase waste management requirements.

blocks.zh: 水桶必須按等級專屬、標示清楚，並在每次使用後消毒。
blocks.en: Buckets must be dedicated by grade, clearly labeled and disinfected after every use.

blocks.zh: 設備與 HVAC 表面
blocks.en: Equipment and HVAC Surfaces

blocks.zh: 非產品接觸面在施用孢子殺滅劑前必須進行預清潔。
blocks.en: Non-product-contact surfaces must be pre-cleaned before the sporicide is applied.

blocks.zh: 難以清潔的表面（軌道、輸送帶底部、輪子）需要有計劃地關注，而非僅在可見髒污時才清潔。
blocks.en: Hard-to-clean surfaces (tracks, undersides of conveyors, wheels) require planned attention rather than cleaning only when visibly dirty.

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器絕不能潤濕。回風格柵和靜壓箱的清潔計劃應由 EM 趨勢數據驅動。
blocks.en: HEPA filters must never be wetted. Cleaning plans for return air grilles and plenums should be driven by EM trend data.

blocks.zh: 地板、排水口與門簾
blocks.en: Floors, Drains and Curtains

blocks.zh: 地板按方向性拖地（從乾淨到髒、從高等級到低等級），施用消毒劑前先移除液體。
blocks.en: Mop floors directionally (from clean to dirty, from higher grade to lower grade), and remove liquid before applying the disinfectant.

blocks.zh: A/B 級排水口在無菌操作期間密封。C/D 級排水口需定期孢子殺滅劑處理，並與 EM 數據相關聯。
blocks.en: Drains in Grade A/B areas are sealed during aseptic operations. Drains in Grade C/D areas require periodic sporicide treatment, correlated with EM data.

blocks.zh: 門簾清潔頻率需高於牆面，並使用低殘留孢子殺滅劑防止殘留物遷移至關鍵區域。
blocks.en: Curtains need to be cleaned more frequently than walls, using low-residue sporicides to prevent residue migration to critical areas.

blocks.zh: 凍乾機 C&D
blocks.en: Lyophilizer C&D

blocks.zh: 每次生產週期後清潔腔體——檢查門墊圈、棚架冷凝水在孢子殺滅劑施用前先去除。
blocks.en: Clean the chamber after every production cycle - inspect the door gasket, and remove shelf condensate before applying the sporicide.

blocks.zh: VHP 是完整腔體去污的首選；次氯酸鈉擦拭也可使用，但必須在驗證時間內用 WFI 沖洗。
blocks.en: VHP is preferred for full chamber decontamination; sodium hypochlorite wiping may also be used, but the surface must be rinsed with WFI within the validated time.

blocks.zh: 所有 C&D 活動記錄在批次記錄中，並與 EM 結果相關聯。
blocks.en: Record all C&D activities in the batch record and correlate them with EM results.

blocks.zh: 腐蝕預防
blocks.en: Corrosion Prevention

blocks.zh: 含氯孢子殺滅劑對 SS316L 腐蝕風險最高——沖洗前切勿讓其乾燥。
blocks.en: Chlorine-based sporicides carry the highest corrosion risk to SS316L - never let them dry before rinsing.

blocks.zh: 引入任何新消毒劑前需要正式的材料相容性數據。
blocks.en: Formal material compatibility data are required before introducing any new disinfectant.

blocks.zh: 驗證沖洗程序（藥劑、體積、週期、殘留限值）是強制要求。
blocks.en: A validated rinsing procedure (agent, volume, cycles, residue limit) is mandatory.

blocks.zh: 腐蝕檢查是例行設備維護的組成部分。
blocks.en: Corrosion inspection is a component of routine equipment maintenance.

blocks.zh: TWi CDMO 應用思考
blocks.en: Reflections on TWi CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 在 TWi 的凍乾機操作中，每次批次結束後的 C&D 流程不只是「清潔工作」——它是批次放行的 GMP 要求之一。操作人員需要理解：為什麼棚架冷凝水的去除、門墊圈的完整性，以及孢子殺滅劑接觸時間後的 WFI 沖洗，每一步都在 EM 結果和最終產品放行中留下可追溯的證據鏈。
blocks.en: In TWi's lyophilizer operations, the C&D process after the end of each batch is not just a "cleaning job" - it is one of the GMP requirements for batch release. Operators need to understand why each step - removal of shelf condensate, integrity of the door gasket, and the WFI rinse after the sporicide contact time - leaves a traceable chain of evidence in the EM results and in the final product release.
